rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; follows the reply's s3.foreign_any-only gate on the foreign tax amount (see ftc.taxes_if_asked; i1116 p. 1, qualified payee statements include Form 1099-DIV). The question itself is asked of the same filers on both sides once the tax is positive. Triage: 2,818/2,995 agree; 16 completed value differences, all the gate cases (classm.f1040.6.deepseek: project true from ftc.all_passive, reply false). Project right; no change.

Ruling: representation; i1116 p. 1, the election is not available with a carryover ("You can’t carry over to or from any other year any foreign" tax under the election). The project asks ftc.carryover also of a filer whose 2024 return included a separate form (s3.prior_other_forms, the screening for any earlier credit form, including a 2024 Form 1116); the reply asks only on s3.foreign_any. A carryover needs an earlier Form 1116, which the project's broader parent reaches, and a carryover refuses the return (ftc.carryover_no_tax / redesign.credits.refuse.ftc_carryover_prior_return). Triage: 2,989/2,995 agree; 6 differences, none on a completed return (5 project-unknown where s3.prior_other_forms is unstated, 1 value on the refused redesign.credits.refuse.ftc_carryover_prior_return). No change.

Ruling: model error; the reply's credit inherits its s3.foreign_any-only gate on ftc.taxes (see ftc.taxes_if_asked; i1116 p. 1, qualified payee statements include Form 1099-DIV and 1099-INT), so it is $0 for a filer with Form 1099-DIV box 7 tax who answered No to the screening question as its help directs. Triage: 2,823/2,995 agree; 13 completed value differences, every one a gate case (classm.f1040.6.deepseek project $195.00, reply $0.00; classm.s2.1 $444.00 / $0.00; classm.scveh.4 $119.00; classm.f8889.1 and stage21.f1.lower_bound_still_decides $241.00; stage5.return.itemized $120.00), and 77 project-refuses on the Form 1116 path (f1116.line35's refusals). The reply's extra test of sa.foreign_tax_deduct matters only on refused returns: a Yes there refuses the return in Schedule A. Both take f1116.line35 when Form 1116 is required and the smaller of tax and regular tax (Form 1040 line 16 plus Schedule 2 line 1z, i1116 p. 25, Line 20) otherwise. Project right; no change.

Ruling: model error; the reply's credit cannot be relied on. Triage (pass 73f790ce759c, 3,002 compared): 352 agree, no value difference on any return; every difference is the reply's own: 2,068 candidate-refuses (with no foreign tax it has no zero branch and routes to f1116.line35, which refuses, e.g. stage14.asset.hy_5yr: project $0.00, f1116.other_category), 579 candidate-unknown (it reads ftc.all_passive and ftc.carryover directly, which the interview asks only when foreign tax was paid), and 3 project-refuses where the project's refusal comes from Form 2441 (f2441.line14_bad), not from this line. It also leaves out requirement 4 of the election, which its own pages carry: i1040gi p. 115, Schedule 3, line 1, 'You aren't filing Form 4563 or excluding income from sources within Puerto Rico'; the project tests it in ftc.needs1116 (sa.excluded_income). The project's credit is the election's 'smaller of (a) your total foreign taxes, or (b)' the regular tax when every condition is met (i1116 pp. 1-2; p. 25, Line 20), Form 1116 line 35 otherwise, and zero with no foreign tax.

Ruling: model error on the regular tax, representation otherwise; i1116 (2025) pp. 1-2, the election to claim the credit without filing Form 1116: the smaller of the foreign tax and the regular tax; p. 25, Line 20, "Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972". As ruled before on this line: the reply names the refusal for a carryover (ftc.carryover_if_asked, BUG-0619), as the project does, and takes Form 1040 line 16 alone as the regular tax, saying no line 1z is supplied. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/ftc.json`, pass c0bc3a63fe27; 1,854 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 149 partial records from 40 bases; 2,503 comparisons): 1,826 agree; 593 candidate-refuses, 48 candidate-unknown and 3 project-refuses on refused returns, 31 candidate-unknown on incomplete ones, and 2 value differences on completed returns: the fixture stage18.ftc_limit_with_repayment ($200.00 of foreign tax, Form 1040 line 16 of $0, an excess advance premium tax credit repayment on Schedule 2: project $200.00, reply $0.00) and generated return 35 ($149.13 of foreign tax, line 16 of $0: project $99.09, reply $0.00). Checked against the page: line 20 adds Schedule 2, Part I, line 1z. Project stands.

Ruling: model error on the regular tax, representation otherwise; i1116 (2025) pp. 1–2, the election to claim the credit without filing Form 1116: the smaller of the foreign tax and the regular tax; p. 25, Line 20, "Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z". The reply now names the new refusal for a carryover (ftc.carryover, BUG-0619; i1116 p. 19, Line 10), as the project does, and takes Form 1040 line 16 alone as the regular tax. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/ftc.json`, pass 0165cdf84695; 1,803 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 172 partial records from 40 bases; 2,475 comparisons): 1,805 agree; 583 candidate-refuses and 51 candidate-unknown on refused returns, 32 candidate-unknown on incomplete ones, 3 project-refuses, and 1 value difference on a completed return, the fixture stage18.ftc_limit_with_repayment: $200.00 of foreign tax, Form 1040 line 16 of $0 and $375 of excess advance premium tax credit repayment (Form 8962 line 29) on Schedule 2; the project's regular tax includes Schedule 2 line 1z and the credit is $200.00, the reply's is $0.00. Checked against the page: line 20 adds Schedule 2, Part I, line 1z. Project stands.

Ruling: model error, with scope for the not-elected return; as the prior ruling of this disagreement. i1116 p. 2, "To make the election, just enter on the foreign tax credit line of your tax return ... the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax, or (b) your regular tax"; p. 25, Line 20, "Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z"; p. 2, Who should file, "File Form 1116 to claim the foreign tax credit if the election, earlier, doesn’t apply". The reply puts the election conditions in the guards and enters $0 when they fail; the project enters $0 without foreign tax and otherwise refuses through ftc.needs1116 (Form 1116 is deferred, not dropped): the prior ruling's scope point. New in this reply: regular tax is Form 1040 line 16 alone, leaving out Schedule 2 line 1z, against p. 25, Line 20: a model error. The gate round changed only which election answers ftc.needs1116 reads (each now behind ftc.has_tax, false without foreign tax), not ftc.credit.

Ruling: model error; on the zero-tax evaluation, with scope for the not-elected return. i1116 p. 2, "To make the election, just enter on the foreign tax credit line of your tax return (for example, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1) the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax, or (b) your regular tax."; p. 2, Who should file, "File Form 1116 to claim the foreign tax credit if the election, earlier, doesn’t apply and: ... You paid or accrued certain foreign taxes"; p. 25, Line 20, "Individuals. Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972." Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/ftc.json; 1,228 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 200 partial records): 1,229 of 1,928 comparisons agree; kinds {"candidate-refuses": 454, "candidate-unknown": 244, "project-refuses": 1}; by return {"completed": {"candidate-unknown": 70}, "incomplete": {"candidate-unknown": 86}, "refused": {"candidate-refuses": 454, "candidate-unknown": 88, "project-refuses": 1}}. Both sides now read regular tax as Form 1040 line 16 plus Schedule 2 line 1z (the BUG-0190 fix), so the limit itself is not in dispute; the candidate's zero floor is redundant, since both terms are NonNegDollars and the Form 8978 and Form 4972 adjustments are refused (scope.other_line16, scope.credits). (1) candidate-unknown (70 on completed returns): with no foreign tax (ftc.taxes $0.00) the candidate still evaluates the election conditions and smaller_of(ftc.taxes, regular tax), so it needs Form 1040 line 16 and the answers below it (witness stage10.ira.fully_taxable, incomplete: project $0.00, candidate unknown for s1a.tips). With no foreign tax the credit is zero whatever the regular tax ("the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax"), so this is an answer the source does not need: a model error. (2) candidate-refuses: every one is on a return the project refuses anyway (for example classm.f8889.5.deepseek, gate scope.schedule1; classm.f4952.3.deepseek, gate sa.dependent): the candidate reaches a refused line 16 on a zero-tax return where the project shows $0.00. No tax quantity differs on a completed return. (3) project-refuses, scope: stage4.refuse.ftc.election (foreign tax with the conditions met and ftc.elect false): the project refuses with gate ftc.needs1116 ("The small-tax election is unavailable or not chosen. Form 1116 is deferred, not dropped"), the candidate enters $0.00. Without the election the credit is claimed on Form 1116 (p. 2, Who should file), which this tool does not prepare; the project's refusal is a cited screen, and the candidate's $0.00 would drop a credit the source allows.

Ruling: model error; i1116 p. 25, Line 20, regular tax is "the total of Form 1040 ... line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z", and p. 2, the election enters "the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax, or (b) your regular tax". The reply limits the credit by Form 1040 line 16 alone, dropping Schedule 2 line 1z (stage18.ftc_limit_with_repayment: project $200.00, reply $0.00). It also reads ftc.elect and ftc.carryover where the interview does not ask them (no foreign tax, e.g. classm.f2441.1; classm.f1040.6.deepseek), so it is unknown there (representation); project refusals are cited (ftc.needs1116 and the election's conditions). Same as the landing round. Triage executable-triage-v2 (pass 39681964b3ef): 2,469/2,671 agree; 151 candidate-unknown, 26 project-refuses, 23 project-unknown, 2 value; on completed returns 33 candidate-unknown, 1 value.

Ruling: model error; i1116 p. 25, Line 20: "Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972" (the regular tax that limits the credit under the election). The reply limits the credit by Form 1040 line 16 alone, dropping Schedule 2 line 1z: completed stage18.ftc_limit_with_repayment ($200 of foreign tax, line 16 $0, Schedule 2 line 1z $375), project $200, reply $0. It also reads the election inputs (ftc.all_passive, ftc.elect, ftc.carryover and others) where the interview does not ask them. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/ftc.json, executable-triage-v2): 1,757 of 2,629 agree; 1 value (completed, the witness above), 641 candidate-unknown (22 completed), 198 candidate-refuses (refused returns, upstream refusals through f1040.line16), 20 project-refuses, 12 project-unknown. Project stands.

Ruling: representation on completed supported returns; i1116 (2025) pp.1-2 Election To Claim ... Without Filing Form1116 explicitly instructs the smaller of total foreign tax and regular tax, despite waiving the Form1116 lines15-23 limitation. That primary text establishes the shared min expression. With positive tax, admitted cases meet the election conditions and both use that min; the reply floors regular tax at zero, redundant for the supported computed nonnegative line16. With zero tax and a completed no-election answer the reply returns zero, as confirmed by .transcription/ftc-zero-tax-source-witness.json. Excluded regimes and absent election answers are not asserted equivalent.

Ruling: model error; follows the reply's s3.foreign_any-only gate on the foreign tax amount (see ftc.taxes_if_asked; i1116 p. 1). Triage: 2,821/2,995 agree; 16 completed value differences, all the gate cases. Project right; no change.

Ruling: representation; i1116 pp. 1-2, Election To Claim the Foreign Tax Credit Without Filing Form 1116. Both sides test total foreign tax above zero; the project reads ftc.taxes only under its parent (dividends, taxable interest or foreign income tax: div.any, interest, s3.foreign_any), where the interview asks it, and is $0 otherwise; the reply reads ftc.taxes directly, so it is unknown where the question is not asked (classm.f2441.1 to .7: project false, reply unknown). No value differs. Same as the landing round. Triage executable-triage-v2 (pass 39681964b3ef): 2,511/2,671 agree; 149 candidate-unknown, 11 project-unknown; on completed returns 32 candidate-unknown, no value.

Ruling: model error; follows the reply's s3.foreign_any-only gate on the foreign tax amount (see ftc.taxes_if_asked; i1116 p. 1). Triage: 2,817/2,995 agree; 16 completed value differences, all the gate cases (classm.f1040.6.deepseek: project true, reply false). Project right; no change.

Ruling: model error; i1116 p. 1, Election To Claim the Foreign Tax Credit Without Filing Form 1116: the election covers foreign tax "reported to you on a qualified payee statement. Qualified payee statements include Form 1099-DIV, Form 1099-INT". The reply asks ftc.taxes only when s3.foreign_any is yes, but that screening question's help tells the filer to count fund tax in Form 1099-DIV box 7 "only if you once filed Form 1116 for it", so a filer with box 7 tax who never filed Form 1116 answers No and the reply drops the tax. The project asks under ftc.asked (dividends, taxable interest or s3.foreign_any), which reaches every payee-statement holder. Triage executable-triage-v2: 2,811/2,995 agree; 16 completed value differences (classm.f1040.6.deepseek project $195.00, reply $0.00; classm.s2.1 $444.00 / $0.00; classm.scveh.4; classm.f8889.1; stage5.return.itemized), all with s3.foreign_any No and Form 1099-DIV tax; the rest on refused or incomplete returns. Project right; no change.
